title: security.change_password
description:
Change passwords.

Change the passwords of users in the native realm and built-in users.

refresh.description: If `true` (the default) then refresh the affected shards to make this operation visible to search, if `wait_for` then wait for a refresh to make this operation visible to search, if `false` then do nothing with refreshes.

password.description: The new password value. Passwords must be at least 6 characters long.

password_hash.description:
A hash of the new password value. This must be produced using the same
hashing algorithm as has been configured for password storage. For more details,
see the explanation of the `xpack.security.authc.password_hashing.algorithm`
setting.

username.description:
The user whose password you want to change. If you do not specify this
parameter, the password is changed for the current user.
